tenderSchedule.locationName: KPTCL SEE Transmission And Mantainance Circle BMAZ South Bengaluru

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have satisfactorily Constructed, Completed & Commissioned Transmission Line of 66kV or above class on Total or Partial Turnkey basis in the last Ten (10) years preceding the date of Bid submission Or The Bidder should have Satisfactorily, Completed & Commissioned the work of Construction/strengthening /re-conductoring of Transmission line/Terminal Bay of 66kV or above voltage class envisaged in the tender on Total or Partial Turnkey basis, in the last Ten (10) years preceding the date of Bid submission. Bidders to upload minimum 3 years experience certificate in execution of electrical works in state/central owned Transmission Utilities/ Generation Utilities/ PSUs/ State/ Central government offices issued by state owned Electricity utilities /Generating utilities only and issuing officer shall not be below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent Division Head.

The Tenderer/Bidder shall possess valid Super Grade Electrical License issued by the Government of Karnataka as on the date of Bid Submission and shall upload the same along with other Bidding documents failing which the offer will be rejected

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Super Grade Electrical License issued by the Government of Karnataka

technicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should possess Valid Labour Registration Certificate issued by the Competent Authority. The bidder should upload the scanned copy of Labour registration certificate issued by the competent authority

The bidder should provide detailed information on any litigation or arbitration arising out of contracts completed or under execution by it over the last five years with KPTCL. A history of awards involving litigations against the bidder or any party or JV may result in rejection of bid. Bidders are requested to furnish the self-declaration stating the above and upload the same along with the other documents in the relevant field in the KPPP portal, failing which the offer is liable to be rejected

The bidder should not have been Blacklisted/Disqualified for non-performance by any State/Central Generating/ Transmission Utility/ PSUs in the past five year as on the date of bid opening. Then in such cases, the offer of the bidder will be summarily rejected. The bidder shall upload a declaration in this regard

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- self declaration for not have been blacklisted

technicalCriterionList.description: Risk & Cost: The offer of the bidder or his Consortium partner is liable for rejection in following cases, Where the Zonal Chief Engineers/ CEE (T&P) have issued notices in respect of ongoing works in the last 6 months as on date of bid submission invoking Risk & Cost clause and where the work is not completed/ charged. Where the Zonal Chief Engineers/ CEE T&P) have issued notices in the last 6 months as on date of bid submission invoking Risk & Cost clause and where the work is completed by KPTCL entrusting it to some other agency. Wherein the works awarded by KPTCL to the bidder has been short closed invoking Contractors default then such bidder shall not be eligible if such short closure has been initiated within 6 months prior to last date of bid submission of this tender. Bidder shall furnish self-declaration stating that no such actions against the bidder have been taken by KPTCL in respect of above and upload the same along with other documents in relevant field in the kppp portal failing which the offer is liable to be rejected

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- self declaration regarding risk and cost

technicalCriterionList.description: Any Bidder from a country which shares a land with India will be eligible to bid in this tender only if the bidder & consortium partner is registered with the Competent Authority as per the provision of Government Order No. FD455 EXP-12 2020 Bengaluru dated 01.04.2023. Such bidder/ Vendor shall meet the eligibility clauses specified in Annexure of the tender document under the heading Model Clause/Certificate/ Undertaking. A certificate/ self- declaration/ undertaking for having read the clauses specified in Annexure are to be uploaded

Achieved in atleast two financial years in the last five years i.e. FY2021-2022 to 2025-2026 a minimum financial turnover of Rs 142.00 Lakhs (Usually not less than Two times the estimated Annual Payments under this Contract) Note, Audited Financial statements ie., Balance sheets, P&L statements, Turnover certificates duly certified by a Chartered Accountant as documentary evidence shall be uploaded. Bidders shall furnish Certificate from Chartered Accountants for split details of financial Turnover and GST in the prescribed format (Annexure-XX).
If part or full price sheets or prices are exposed in the Techno-Commercial Sheets or Techno-Commercial Bid by the Bidder, then the offer of the Bidder will be rejected

The bidder should have Goods and Service Tax (GST) Registration and shall upload the necessary supporting documents to establish compliance for having GST registration and shall upload the scanned copy of PAN
The bidder should possess valid EPF Certificate and shall upload the scanned copy EPF certificates
The bidder should possess valid ESI Certificate and shall upload the scanned copy of ESI certificates

The tenderer should produce the Power of attorney on stamp paper of Rs 500/-. Copies of original documents defining the constitution or Legel status, place of Registration and Principal place of Business of the Bidder, written Power of Attorney to the Signatory of the Bid to commit the bidder to the contract along with the resolution passed in this regard by the Board of Directors/ all the Partners of the Firm

Bidder shall be financially sound and shall submit audited financial reports for last five years preceding the date of Bid submission. Bidder shall have adequate knowledge of Sub-Stations and Transmission lines design procedures including Quality control and shall have infrastructure and erection facilities and capacity to execute the works

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

self declaration for not having blackl listed in any of the electrical Utility of Gvt Central Govt Organisation, Institution/industries as on the date of bid opening
Labour Registration Certificate issued by labour department, GOK.
Any other documents as per tender documents
